additional_info.subject: RE: 0402077 - ID0402077-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / P9 170001023] SCB offline. CRM:00755000182
additional_info.body:
Hallo Rudi
Hier die Zusammenfassung:
After the onsite visit, we identified an error that you can see in the picture. Additionally, upon checking the 2nd CFAST card, we decided to prepare a new USB for the Linux scripts and also seek assistance from the R&D team. Benjamin overrote the script and changed the CFAST card acknowledgment without seeking approval. In any case, even if the CFAST card is inserted, it should be able to read it. However, the PLC did not recognize any card, so we concluded that the card reader in the PLC is faulty and unable to read the CFAST card. Therefore we will replace the PLC and flash the CFAST
Es müsste also ein PLC bestellt werden B
6ES7677-2DB40-0GB0
-KF1
ET200 Open Controller Linux
Basic
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Semih
